1. In test/letflow/event_store/registry_test.exs: provision a real tenant, then execute a raw DROP SCHEMA <name> CASCADE against it directly (simulating the concurrent-teardown race), then call register_type/2 (and/or get_type/2) against that tenant_id and assert {:error, :tenant_schema_missing} is returned -- not a crash.
2. In test/letflow/tenant_provisioning/backfill_test.exs: set up a scenario with at least 2 Registration rows, drop one tenant's schema before calling Backfill.run/1, and assert run/1 completes (does not crash), the dropped tenant is counted in :skipped, and the other tenant is still processed/counted in :updated.
3. Fail-then-pass proof (mandatory): check out the pre-fix commit in a throwaway git worktree (parent of 4d20542 on this branch), run ONLY these new tests against it, confirm they fail (real crash/exception, quote it), then confirm they pass on this branch. Remove the worktree when done.
4. Complete the handoff with artifacts_out: ["test/letflow/event_store/registry_test.exs", "test/letflow/tenant_provisioning/backfill_test.exs"], next_action: "Route to TEST-DESIGN-VALIDATOR".
5. Commit on feature/WF03-ISS0343-20260826 and push.
